title: spec page.zod.ts describes: state that an authored kind full record page applies on the desktop full page only (#36150), and the record_more remedy; regenerate artifacts
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Companion to #36150 (PR #36174, `Metadata-protocol: semantic`). It was raised as S1 (should-fix) by the seat's contract review on PR #36174. That PR changes behaviour in the console only, and spec text is a governed surface with its own schema-face review, so the published contract's wording is this card.

## The gap

Since #36150, an authored `kind: 'full'` record page assigned to an object applies only on the desktop full page. On phone and in the side preview, the standard record page is drawn. Named-page routes and slotted pages are unchanged, and the approval request page and the user page keep their own page everywhere (rulings 7066490078 and 7066506909). The spec on `main` still reads as if the page applies wherever the record opens:
- `packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts` says `isDefault` is "the page the record view opens", and says `apps` names the route that "opens this page".
- The `slots.tabs` tombstone prescribes `kind: 'full'`, "drawn as authored", with no surface rule.
- The `record_section` action location says nothing about the standard page not drawing it. `record_more` is the remedy.

## What to do

1. Reword the describes of `kind`, `isDefault` and `apps`, and the tombstone remedy, to state the surface rule and the `record_more` remedy.
2. Regenerate the generated schema and docs artifacts.
3. Make no shape change. This is a describe-text change, so `Metadata-protocol: semantic`, a spec `patch` or `minor` per ruling A, and a Fable L2 on the schema face.

Related: #36179, the skills wording for the same rule (a `domain:skills` PR). The two can be read together, but land them separately. Start after PR #36174 merges.
